text:
sam: Quick flag from rv4 bring-up in staging: overall NDCG@10 +1.0% but MRR@5 on very short queries (<=4 tokens) drops -3.8%. Putting quick numbers.

ivy: Paste the slice table pls.

sam:
```
overall  NDCG@10 +1.0%  MRR@5 -0.5%
short   NDCG@10 +0.4%  MRR@5 -3.8%
long    NDCG@10 +1.8%  MRR@5 +1.2%
```
Changed pieces: new candidate dedupe normalizer (strip_symbols), unify_tok v3 with nfkc, and shipped int8 PTQ.

omar: My money is on strip_symbols + nfkc changing exact-match anchors for short queries. Quant might amplify but unlikely to be primary.

eval-bot: Queued quick ablation: A) legacy_tok + fp16 B) nfkc + fp16 C) nfkc + int8. ETA ~12m.

ivy: Also measure top1_prob and exact_match_rate; MRR moves mostly from top1 loss.

eval-bot: Results: A recovers short MRR (~+3.6pp), B matches regression, C slightly worse (~-0.6pp extra).

sam: Conclusion: token/formatting change caused main regression; int8 marginally worsens. Plan: revert strip_symbols for queries <=4 tokens and run 5% A/B. Filing rollout: go/rollout/rv4-shorttok-exception

ivy: Add tokenizer unit tests with short-query anchors and languages with punctuation-heavy queries.

sam: Will follow up with A/B results. Thanks.
